expectation: CDX2 is a nuclear stain. It should light the nuclei of intestinal epithelium (villus and crypt enterocytes and goblet cells) brightly, with crisp nuclear dots lining the mucosal epithelium. Stroma, lamina propria and muscularis should be negative.
observed: A: yellow fills the whole section, muscularis included, with tile stripes. B and C: haze over stroma and cytoplasm; the epithelial nuclei (blue) are dark, not lit. D: blobs not on nuclei. E1: haze with nuclear holes. E2: Ecadherin has no structure.
why: The signal is haze that follows the tissue, muscle and stroma, with tile stripes, and epithelial nuclei are not stained, so there is no nuclear CDX2 population.
notes: The haze covers the whole section, muscle wall included, with tile seams. In the crypt and villus fields the epithelial nuclei are dark under the yellow, so there are no nuclear CDX2 cells. Ecadherin shows no structure, so row E adds nothing.
